name: Denver
note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid, the South Platte and the Front Range carry the fit; the 1908 staged sheet is the steepest (near-vertical) whole-city view in the pool, drawn from the north (the Twenty-Third Street Viaduct, ~1.3 km north of the point) looking south - the grid dense and legible to the southern suburbs, the Front Range along the southern horizon, a printed landmark index - spanning the whole city beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)

name: St. Paul
note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid, the Minnesota and Mississippi rivers carry the fit; the 1906 staged sheet is the steepest (near-vertical) whole-city view in the pool, drawn from a high vantage on the east (the Minnesota side) looking west - the river confluence at the bottom of the sheet, the dense downtown grid centre-right on the Mississippi's west bank, the farmland horizon across the top (the west) - spanning the whole city beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)

name: Minneapolis
note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid and the Mississippi carry the fit; the 1885 staged sheet is the steepest (near-vertical) whole-city view in the pool (the built-up city fills the whole frame, no horizon band), drawn from a high vantage on the south/southwest of the city (the west bank, below the downtown) - the sheet faces ~NNW: the Mississippi enters upper-left (the rapids below the falls, the long arch viaduct and its weir) and runs to the lower-right toward the confluence (off-sheet past the bottom edge); the dense west-bank downtown core sits upper-left of the 3rd Street suspension bridge (the two-tower masonry span at the sheet's mid-right), the brickyard and the river's downstream bend fill the lower right - spanning the whole city beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)
